actor.description: The actor whose attestation key set is being grown. Must agree with the envelope subject. Cross-actor attestation key add is invalid.

subject.description: Internal reference of the same actor: 'actor:<self-actor-id>'.

created_at.description: Strict RFC 3339 UTC seconds (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). The verifier treats this as the causal position at which new_key joins the attestation set.

bytes.description: Raw ed25519 public key bytes encoded with standard base64. Must be disjoint from the actor's signing keys (genesis-initial, rotation chain, emergency rotation chain).

signatures.description: Each signature must be produced by a distinct key in the actor's attestation set at created_at. The verifier requires >= attestation_threshold_at(actor, created_at) entries with distinct key_id values. Operational signing keys cannot grow the attestation set. See ACTORS.md §5.5.2 / §5.5.3.
